# routeros_routing_bgp_session (Data Source)


Reads live BGP session state from `/routing/bgp/session` on the configured RouterOS device. Returned attributes reflect the router state at the time of the Terraform read (useful in verification or standalone inventory workspaces).

---

## Example Usage
```terraform
data "routeros_routing_bgp_session" "established" {
  filter = {
    established = "true"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Map of String) Additional request filtering options.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sessions` (List of Object) Live BGP session observations at the time of the Terraform read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))
